__broaden__.αὐτὸν: αὐτός — self; masc. acc. sg., reinforcing a pronoun: ’me myself’ (ἔμ’ αὐτὸν) · also plain personal pronoun after a preposition: ’him’ (παρ’ αὐτὸν ’beside him’) · also intensive, with the object already named by a pronoun: ’you yourself’ (σε … αὐτὸν δὲ κλαίοντα ’you yourself, weeping’) · also plain personal pronoun as direct object: ’him’ (αὐτὸν σεύωνται ’they set upon him’)
__broaden__.γένηται: γίγνομαι — become, come to be; aor. subj. 3 sg., in a conditional clause after εἴ ποτε: ’if there ever comes to be’ · also in an indefinite relative clause with κε: ’proves, turns out’ (κρείσσων γένηται ’proves the stronger’)
__broaden__.δῶρ: δῶρον — gift; neut. acc. pl., elided (δῶρ’ = δῶρα) · also neut. nom. pl., elided: ’gifts’ (δῶρ’ Ἀφροδίτης ’the gifts of Aphrodite’)
__broaden__.εἶδος: εἶδος — form, look, beauty; neut. acc. sg. (accusative of respect): ’in beauty’ · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’form, good looks’ (τό τε εἶδος ’and the looks’)
__broaden__.εὖτ: εὖτε (elided εὖτ’) — when, whenever; temporal conj. (with ἄν + subj.) · also with an aor. indic. in a simile: ’when’ (εὖτ’ … κατέχευεν ’when he has poured’)
__broaden__.καλλιγύναικα: καλλιγύναιξ — with fair women; adj. (2-term.), fem. acc. sg., agreeing with Ἑλλάδα · also fem. acc. sg., agreeing with Ἀχαιΐδα ’Achaea’
__broaden__.καλὸν: καλός — beautiful, fair, fine; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with παιήονα: ’a fair (paean)’ · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with εἶδος: ’fair’
__broaden__.κατ: κατά (elided κατ’) — down from, down along; + gen./acc.; also a preverb in tmesis (κατ’ … ἕζετο = καθέζετο ’sat down’) · also κατ’ ἔμ’ αὐτόν ’by myself, alone’ (κατά + acc.) · also κατ’ αἶσαν ’according to due measure, rightly’ (κατά + acc.)
__broaden__.κεν: κε(ν) — epic particle (= Attic ἄν); with the opt., potential: ’might, would’; with the subj. in conditions after εἰ, αἰ · also + subj. or fut. indic. in a main or relative clause: ’shall’ (’I shall take’; ’to whom I come’) · also + subj. in a general relative clause: ’whatever’ (ὅττί κεν εἴπῃς) · also with a past indic., contrary to fact: ’would have’ (ἔνθά κεν … ἐτύχθη) · also with an impf. indic., past potential: ’would be’ (κεν … κέρδιον ἦεν ’it would be better’)
__broaden__.κοῦροι: κοῦρος — young man, boy; masc. nom. pl. · also masc. voc. pl., in address: ’youths!’ (κοῦροι Ἀχαιῶν ’youths of the Achaeans’)
__broaden__.κῆρ: κῆρ — heart; neut. nom./acc. sg.; as accusative of respect, χωόμενος κῆρ ’incensed in heart’ · also κήρ — doom, death-fate; fem. acc. sg., elided (κῆρ’ = κῆρα): ’death-fate’
__broaden__.μακρὰ: μακρός — long, tall; neut. acc. pl., agreeing with ἕρματα · also agreeing with κύματα: ’tall (waves)’ · also neut. acc. pl. used adverbially with βοάω: ’loudly’ (μακρὰ βοῶν) · also neut. acc. pl. used adverbially with βιβάντα: ’with long (strides)’
__broaden__.μακρὸν: μακρός — long, tall, high; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with Ὄλυμπον · also neut. acc. sg. used adverbially with ἄϋσεν: ’loudly’
__broaden__.τά: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. pl., ’those things’; accented before an enclitic · also relative, neut. nom. pl.: ’which’ (τά τ’ αἰδῶ ἀμφικαλύπτει ’which cover the shame’) · also neut. nom. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τά τε δῶρ’ Ἀφροδίτης ’and the gifts of Aphrodite’)
__broaden__.τίς: τίς, τί — who? what?; interrog. pron., masc./fem. nom. sg. · also indefinite τις after ὅς, written τίς: ’anyone, someone’ (ὅς τίς σφιν … ἡγήσαιτο ’anyone to lead them’) · also indefinite, written τίς: ’someone, one’ (ὡς δ’ ὅτε τίς τε δράκοντα ἰδών ’as when someone, seeing a snake’)
__broaden__.τό: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg. ’it, that’, often with γε: ’that at least’ · also neut. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τό τε εἶδος ’and the looks’)
__broaden__.ἀργεῖοι: Ἀργεῖοι — the Argives, i.e. the Greeks; masc. nom. pl. · also masc. voc. pl., in address: ’Argives!’
__broaden__.ἀρηΐφιλον: ἀρηΐφιλος — dear to Ares, warlike; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ἀρχόν · also masc. acc. sg., epithet of Menelaus
__broaden__.ἂν: ἀνά — up, aboard; prep./preverb, with apocope ἂν before δ’; in tmesis (ἂν … βήσομεν ’put aboard’) · also modal particle ἄν (= κεν) written ἂν: with the opt., potential: ’would’; with the subj. after εὖτ’: ’whenever’ · also with ὡς + subj.: ’in the way that’ (ὡς ἂν ἐγὼ εἴπω ’as I may say’) · also modal particle with the subj. after ὅτ’: ’whenever’ (ὅτ’ ἂν … γένωνται ’whenever they come to be’) · also modal particle with a fut. or short-vowel subj.: ’could’ (οὐκ ἂν … μυθήσομαι ’I could not tell’) · also εἴ περ ἂν + opt., ’even if … should’ · also εἴ περ ἂν + subj., ’even if … ever’ (εἴ περ ἂν αὐτὸν σεύωνται ’even if they set upon him’)
__broaden__.ἐπ: ἐπί (elided ἐπ’) — on, upon, over, at; + dat./acc./gen. · also + acc., ’to, towards’ (βῆ δ’ ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδην ’went to the son of Atreus’) · also + dat., ’to’ (πέμψαι ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδῃ ’to send to’) · also preverb in tmesis (ἐπ’ … θήσειν ’to lay upon’) · also + acc. of time, ’until, at’ (ἐπ’ ἠέλιον δῦναι ’until the sun sets’) · also + dat., ’against’ (ἐπ’ ἀλλήλοισιν ἰόντες ’coming against one another’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (ἐπ’ ὠκεανοῖο ῥοάων ’toward the streams of Oceanus’)
__broaden__.ἐριβώλακα: ἐρίβωλαξ — of rich soil, with large clods; fem. acc. sg., with Λάρισαν · also fem. acc. sg., epithet of Troy (Τροίην ἐριβώλακα)
__broaden__.ἔπ: ἐπί — to, towards; prep. + acc., following its noun with accent thrown back (ἔπι) and elided (ἔπ’) · also = ἔπεστι, ’is upon’: ἔπι (ἔπ’) as predicate, no case (εἶδος ἔπ’ ’beauty is upon him’)
__broaden__.ἥ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); fem. nom. sg., accented ἥ before γε: ’she’ · also fem. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ἥ τε κόμη ’and the hair’)
__broaden__.ὑπὲρ: ὑπέρ — over, beyond; + gen.: ’on behalf of’ (ὑπὲρ Δαναῶν) · also + acc., ’beyond’ (ὑπὲρ αἶσαν ’beyond due measure’)
__broaden__.ὅσσά: ὅσος — as great, as many as; neut. nom. pl., epic -σσ- (= Attic ὅσα): ’as many as’ · also neut. acc. pl., object of its verb: ’whatever’ (ὅσσά κεν αὐτοὶ δῶσιν ’whatever they themselves may give’)
